contenu:
resources:
  repositories:
  - repository: mesx-ops-pipelines
    type: git
    name: MES_X.0/mesx-ops-pipelines

trigger:
  tags:
    include:
    - '*'
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - ci/*
  paths:
    exclude:
    - README.md

variables:
  isMain: $[eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')]
  caAppName: input-dis

stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
 
  - template: build/jobs/jobs-docker-build.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      repository: mesx/input-binding
      npmauth: false

- stage: Dev
  condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables.isMain, true))
  jobs:
  - template: deploy/jobs/jobs-container-apps-deploy.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      azureSubscription: spn-dev-inf-mes
      pipelineDeploymentEnvironment: app_cloud_dev_mes
      containerAppName: ca-gptmpxn01-eun-dev-input-di
      containerAppResourceGroupName: rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-mes-01

apiVersion: dapr.io/v1alpha1
kind: Component
metadata:
  name: bindings-wip-dbo-shop-order-input-di
spec:
  type: bindings.azure.eventhubs
  version: v1
  metadata:
  - name: eventHubNamespace
    value: ehn-gptmpxn01-eun-dev-core-01.servicebus.windows.net
  - name: eventHub
    value: "dbz.wip.wip.dbo.shop_order"
  - name: consumerGroup
    value: "test"
  - name: enableInOrderMessageDelivery
    value: "true"
  - name: enableEntityManagement
    value: "false"
  - name: storageAccountName
    value: "statgptmpxn01mes01"
  - name: storageContainerName
    value: "ca01missaou-dapr-binding"
  - name: getAllMessageProperties
    value: "true"
  - name: direction
    value: "input"
